subtopics.title: Selecting Evaluation Methods
subtopics.summary: Choosing appropriate evaluation methods such as toxicity classifiers, semantic similarity, and AI judges based on specific criteria, including the use of scoring rubrics and examples for specialized scorers.

subtopics.title: Annotating Evaluation Data
subtopics.summary: The process of labeling and preparing evaluation data, including determining the necessary volume of examples to ensure reliable results without being prohibitively expensive.

subtopics.title: Designing Evaluation Data Slices
subtopics.summary: Creating multiple evaluation sets to represent different data slices, such as production distribution, user tiers, traffic sources, known failure cases, and out-of-scope inputs.
